preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of queries n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(k == 2 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the base k is always 2.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= y <= 2 * 10**7 for y in queries)
postconditions.description: Each query y is between 0 and 20,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(r in {0, 1, -1} for r in responses)
postconditions.description: Each response r is either 0, 1, or -1.
The final response r for each test case is 1, indicating the password was guessed correctly.
